verdict.rationale: Grafana documents both a hosted Cloud MCP Server and a self-managed open-source MCP Server (mcp-grafana) that let external agents query metrics, logs, traces, alerts and dashboards, plus a public OpenAPI spec and natural-language query support in Grafana Cloud AI tools. This directly satisfies the story of an external agent querying observability data through documented APIs to debug production. Missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of the MCP server's reliability/coverage for complex production debugging scenarios, and explicit documentation tying MCP queries to full incident-debugging workflows.
